I’ve been trying to recover my account for over a year but instagram removed their account recovery team and replaced it with a link to an expired help article. I continued  using the app for my secondary account without linking them (just uploaded the photos and rearranged them to see what they would look like without logging in to insta) but now on top of everything,
every time I try to open the app it’s just a white screen. 

Also the paid version is an absolutely unrealistically high price per month. Insane. Would give zero stars if I could.

reviews.title: Once great app now unusable
reviews.text: I’ve had this app for years and it used to be great — easy to load your feed by logging into your account (as mine is private), easy to add photos, to preview, no ads. There was some issue years back where it wouldn’t let me login properly. Eventually I could. Eventually they put ads on which is fair enough — but now they bombard you with a subscription to pay for certain features, and it comes up in a way where I bet many people don’t even know you can use it for free. But the ads are insufferable — one comes up after ACTION you make. Delete a photo? Ad. Add a photo? Ad. So on. And now, the worst which has made it definitely unusable for me: I have a private account so have to login, but now it won’t let me do that and use their app unless I change my account to a professional one. Ridiculous. I would’ve given this app like 4 or 5 stars many years back. How it is right now is worth 1 star to me. It’s messy, cluttered, and unusable to someone like me who uses it with a private account just to keep my feed looking aesthetically pleasing. A simple and useful app ruined.
